an10.16:1.1: bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an10.16:1.3: Tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, paccekasambuddho, ubhatobhāgavimutto. paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhi, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī, gotrabhū.
an10.16:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dasa puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā
